description.value:
Trigger A creature ends its movement on the bridge

Effect The bumper bridge attempts to [[/act shove]] that creature into the river with an Athletics bonus of [[/gmr 1d20+9 #Athletics]]{+9}. If the triggering creature was not aware of this hazard, they take a –2 circumstance penalty to their Fortitude DC. The bumper bridge then rolls initiative.

details.description: The bumpers on the bridge push forward, attempting to knock competitors into the river.

publication.title: Starfinder Society Scenario #1-04: The Great Absalom Relay

details.routine: (3 actions) The bumper bridge attempts to [[/act shove]] all creatures on the bridge into the river with an Athletics bonus of [[/gmr 1d20+9 #Athletics]]{+9} (no multiple attack penalty).
